versions.title: SGGF 1.5
versions.description: Castle Hall is rebuilt to match the F1.4 fortress. The left door leads to the Mage Room; the middle door returns outside unchanged; the right door is an interactable, permanently locked bank vault with item-specific Zork-style dialogue. The existing off-centre platter seam remains, with a persistent Special Hard Hitbox slider controlling target precision. Previous world transitions, movement mesh, gameplay, and saves are retained.

versions.title: SGGF 1.4
versions.description: Castle Exterior rebuilt to match the F1.3 Castle Path fortress: pale round stone arch, deep vaulted opening, raised portcullis, open timber gate leaves, square crenellated towers and a centered cobbled approach. Castle Path, transitions, movement, collision, gameplay and save data remain unchanged.

versions.title: SGGF 1.3
versions.description: Castle Path navigation clarity: the temporary threshold guide line is removed; a Castle Exterior arrow and label sit just beyond the unchanged invisible crossing boundary; returning from Castle Exterior places Spiffy safely on the lower approach. All F1.2 gameplay and other art are retained.

versions.title: SGGF 1.2
versions.description: Horse rendering polish: all horse polygons now render both their solid fill and outline, and the Stables foreground fence is correctly drawn behind the horse. The F1.1 horse design, carriage, Kitty, stable geometry and Part One gameplay are preserved.

versions.title: SGGF 1.1
versions.description: Stable-yard art refinement: the original carriage, a new dark-bay draft horse, and the foreground paddock fence are independent JSON assets and world objects. F1.0 story, quests, Kitty, walkmesh and gameplay are preserved.

versions.title: SGGF 1.0
versions.description: Part One finale: rebuilt Stables, the hangry carriage driver, Fearmonger's Egg McGuffin Sammich reward, the carriage breakfast handoff, and Cozmo's thank-you. Includes the existing anonymous comments feature.

versions.title: SGGE 5.7
versions.description: Anonymous visitor comments are now available through the separate private comments inbox. All E5.6 world art and gameplay are preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 5.6
versions.description: Castle Path paving now begins inside the open gate, runs through the threshold, and widens into a graded hillside road with retaining walls; upper-bend transition remains aligned.

versions.title: SGGE 5.5
versions.description: Castle Path broad sweep and open gatehouse, a visible gold transition marker, aligned road landings, and the Black-Briar Mead dialogue gag for the Kartlotta quest.

versions.title: SGGE 5.4
versions.description: Castle Path perspective rebuild: a tapered stone road follows the hillside toward the castle. The automatic Castle Exterior transition now occurs at the upper bend, near Spiffy’s reference position; return landing and lower approach align with the road.

versions.title: SGGE 5.3
versions.description: Castle Path rebuilt as a grounded mountain approach: a continuous winding stone road, fortress embedded in the ridge, rooted woodland, and navigation generated from the same smooth centerline. Existing transitions preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 5.2
versions.description: Castle Path visual rebuild: a detailed stone-paved switchback through richer foothills and woodland, with the existing navigation corridor and every transition preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 5.1
versions.description: Gold District refined: more believable mansion windows, restrained timberwork, and a grounded castle gateway with corrected directional travel. Skywalking eliminated.

versions.title: SGGE 5.0
versions.description: Gold District rebuilt from scratch: two distinct houses, elegant fountain, refined landscaping, and a proper castle-bound avenue. All previous releases preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 4.9
versions.description: A complete, playable Tipsy Turnip Inn Interior rebuild: integrated hearth/cookpot, reachable mead/platter, reworked NPCs and walkmesh. All other areas and history preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 4.8
versions.description: Tipsy Turnip Inn Outside rebuilt from scratch: asymmetric timber-and-stone tavern, detailed roof and cobbled forecourt, single doorway, animals retained. No gameplay changes.

versions.title: SGGE 4.7
versions.description: Inn Outside full art rebuild in the Britrun Market style; no intended gameplay logic changes.

versions.title: SGGE 4.6
versions.description: Alchemy Shop isolated layer surgery: removes orphan stand and side posts; makes south exit render once with a single authored door. World and walk-through rules unchanged.

versions.title: SGGE 4.5
versions.description: Alchemy Shop visual cleanup only: removed the stray lower-center noise block and replaced the stacked, conflicting interior exit art with a single clean doorway. Door logic and walkmesh remain unchanged from E4.4.

versions.title: SGGE 4.4
versions.description: Alchemy Shop visual cleanup only: removed the stray lower-center stand/noise and replaced the sunken-rug interior exit with a simpler stone-threshold door treatment. Door logic and walkmesh unchanged from E4.3.

versions.title: SGGE 4.3
versions.description: Alchemy Shop exit artwork rebuilt as a grounded southbound threshold; extraneous brown torch posts removed; laboratory table collision footprint aligned to actual furniture; export log filenames now include seconds. Directional doors/E key unchanged.

versions.title: SGGE 4.2
versions.description: BritRun Market exterior Alchemy Shop door aligned to reachable collision boundary; no other door, interaction or artwork changes. Flight recorder retained.

versions.title: SGGE 4.1
versions.description: Reliable walk-into doorways; in-memory diagnostic flight recorder and EXPORT LOG; optional browser-authorized log folder in F1 Settings. Original scenes and prior releases retained.

versions.title: SGGE 4.0
versions.description: Simplified controls: E acts ONLY on hovered reachable objects/people; walk into doors to transition automatically. Inn doorway opened. All older versions preserved.

versions.title: SGGE 3.5
versions.description: Alchemy Shop worktop placement: items now sit on real furniture, accessible by E or clicking. Bucket theft remains meaningful.

versions.title: SGGE 3.4
versions.description: The Alchemy Shop Reimagined: cohesive apothecary art, reachable merchandise, and the original bucket-stealing gameplay. The Market remains untouched.

versions.title: SGGE 3.3
versions.description: Fast travel! Press M to select any of the 21 areas, including Kelp's Castle Vault, without quest prerequisites.

versions.title: SGGE 3.2
versions.description: The Multi-Mind Canvas begins: DeepSeek/Kelp reimagines the Castle Vault. All other game scenes and mechanics remain E3.1.

versions.title: SGGE 3.1
versions.description: The Market Reimagined — a fully repainted Britrun square, original character art, and corrected walkable ground.

versions.title: SGGE 3.0
versions.description: A rebuilt Britrun: redesigned inns, richer neighborhoods, winding roads, walkable terrain, animated animals and a shaggy Frost Troll.

versions.title: SGGE 2.1
versions.description: Adjustable text (up to 32 pt), fullscreen display, and the tested canvas repair.

versions.title: SGGE 2.0
versions.description: The first stable browser release — an archived playable milestone.
